paragraphs.text: Which was either a musical instrument or a solemn tune, to which this psalm was sung.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: In all manner of troubles God shows his speedy mercy and power in defending his.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: That is, we will not be overcome with fear.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Though the afflictions rage, yet the rivers of God's mercies bring sufficient comfort to his.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: The river of Shiloh, which passed through Jerusalem: meaning, though the defence seems small, yet if God has appointed it, it is sufficient.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: They are assured that God can and will defend his Church from all dangers and enemies.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, how often he has destroyed his enemies, and delivered his people.
paragraphs.label: h
paragraphs.anchor: what desolations he hath made in

paragraphs.text: He warns them who persecute the Church to cease their cruelty: for also they will feel that God is too strong for them against whom they fight.
paragraphs.label: i
